decision: The reproduced per-label deficit is a preprocessing bug, not an accepted method difference. Keep the per-label Dice >= 0.95 gate.
originalClaim: The original 10/26-label, minimum-Dice 0.693 regression pin and report were not found. This independently reproduces the failure class on labeled public data; it does not reproduce that exact historical score.

inputs.derivation: nibabel array[:, :, :17], preserve affine and original int16 header; saving autoscales integer storage and changes intensities by at most 0.004180908203125

limitations: References establish agreement with the upstream implementation on these public MRI inputs, not anatomical ground truth or CT validation.
WebGPU was tested on software SwiftShader, not a hardware GPU.
Full knee reference uses explicitly modified bounded channel inversion, with exact pre-cleanup equivalence verified on three labeled subsets and one background subset.
The historical full-knee chunk-size-5 reference is not regenerated here; full-knee validation uses the published chunk-size-45, overlap-0 reference.
Forward affine fixture coverage does not establish full inference parity for arbitrary sheared affines.

baselineRegressionTests.note: Run against baseline worker and monai-compat sources with the same synthetic upstream fixture.

historicalCasesNote: These record the baseline and intermediate fixes, before the final arithmetic and temporary-file roundtrip corrections. Final measured cases are recorded separately.
rootCauses: Foreground crop used all nonzero normalized voxels instead of MONAI positive selection.
Sampling matrices and grid calculations used float32 and a different PyTorch linspace and accumulation order, altering exact-zero support before normalization.
Multiple source chunks skipped upstream temporary NIfTI integer-storage write/reload. That reload must scale through float64 before conversion to float32, matching the actual MONAI loader.

stageEvidence.forwardSpacing: 13 saved anatomical cases, including all nine historical knee chunks, matched spaced float32 arrays and crop bounds exactly.
stageEvidence.integerChunkRoundtrip: Corrected production helper matches 118 independent Nibabel float64-decode cases, 28,548,252 values byte for byte. Actual MONAI LoadImage matches all 60 compact synthetic fixtures and all three complete affected body chunks.
stageEvidence.tests: Synthetic upstream oracles constrain behavior; no measured Dice scores are used as test thresholds.
stageEvidence.loaderOracleCorrection: The earlier float32-read fixture validated a different Nibabel read path. It is superseded by the actual MONAI float64-read proof; 17 of 60 corrected fixtures fail against the earlier helper.

bodyResidualInvestigation.decision: Accept the isolated inference-runtime numerical differences under the unchanged Dice >= 0.95 per-label gate; do not modify labels, reference masks, tie-breaking or thresholds.

pairedInference.method: Foreground minus background logit at the original voxel. Actual app inferSliceLogits and torch-grid inverse coordinates, identical input arrays and JavaScript aggregation/inversion for WASM versus native ORT. All other channels retained during inference.
pairedInference.conclusion: All three winners change when only inference runtime/backend changes, including with the exact upstream MONAI tensor. Residual labels are numerical inference differences; no evidence supports label-specific thresholding or lowered Dice requirements.

bodyResidualInvestigation.qualification: Native ORT version and execution provider differ from browser WASM. This experiment isolates inference runtime changes, not a specific defective kernel. Normalization rounding cannot explain these three differences because they persist with identical upstream tensors.
bodyResidualInvestigation.pipelineVersionNote: Full-knee, single-slice WebGPU and unsplit subset runs bypass the corrected integer temporary-file helper. Their earlier helper source hash records the tested revision; this change is exercised by the corrected multi-chunk and full-body runs.
